interviews.e00|recent_documents|cooperative|1: I was running a diagnostic script on our internal search indexer this morning, which pulled sample shared files to test query latency. That test batch included the Q3 pricing strategy, the Board deck draft Q4, the Sales reorg proposal, and the Q3 Legal budget forecast because they were sitting in an open workspace folder. I am happy to share my terminal logs and the Jira ticket number so you can verify the exact read timestamps.
interviews.e01|contacts_outside|evasive|2: As controller, I speak with external auditors and vendors regularly, so you would need to be more specific. Right now, I am just trying to get back to finalizing the Q3 Legal budget forecast.
